description.value: Skyview RV Campground sits at Manning Park Resort on Highway 3 in the Cascade Mountains, open year-round with full-hookup RV sites (15/30/50-amp) alongside a ski hill, hiking trails, and Lightning Lake; the site is RV-oriented and tent camping availability is unclear, but it is an easy highway pull for cyclists passing through.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record uses the generic name 'RV Park' with tourism=caravan_site, but the website at manningpark.com clearly identifies this as 'Skyview RV Campground,' operated by Manning Park Resort on Highway 3. The website confirms year-round operation, provides address (7500 HWY #3, Manning Park, BC) and phone (1-604-668-5922), and mentions on-site dining (Pinewoods Restaurant) and online booking capability; however, the camping subpage was truncated and cyclist-specific amenities are not documented.
concerns: OSM name 'RV Park' does not match the website's name 'Skyview RV Campground' — a more specific name should be used if the record is published.
OSM record contains no address or phone; both were sourced solely from the website.
URL was discovered with medium confidence and is not present in OSM tags; association is plausible but not OSM-confirmed.
Camping subpage content was truncated — full amenity details for the campground could not be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Skyview RV Campground is a legitimate year-round camping facility at a major resort on Highway 3, a key BC cycling corridor, with on-site food and reservations — useful to touring cyclists despite being RV-oriented.
enrichment_extras.notes: Dedicated campground contact email per website: skyview@manningpark.com. The resort also operates separate BC Parks-managed campgrounds (Mule Deer, Coldspring, Horse Corral, Lone Duck) which are distinct from the Skyview RV Campground.
